A\n  // vacuously-holding claim answers 'P' and would be filed \"no witness within\n  // the bound\"; a claim that was never generated has no verdict and would be\n  // filed \"not solved this run\". Both are statements about the path, and both\n  // are strictly less informative than the truth, which is that nothing ran.\n  {\n    const size_t p = claim_key.first.rfind(\":path:\");\n    const std::string unit =\n      p == std::string::npos ? claim_key.first : claim_key.first.substr(0, p);\n    if (units_not_entered.count(unit) != 0)\n      return \"unit-not-entered\";\n  }\n\n  char v = 0;\n  {\n    std::lock_guard lock(claim_outcome_mutex);\n    auto it = claim_outcome.find(claim_key.first + \"\\t\" + claim_key.second);\n    if (it != claim_outcome.end())\n      v = it->second;\n  }\n  switch (v)\n  {\n  case 'P':\n    // Proven at THIS exploration. See the header comment: this\n  // narrowing came from the audit's first real run, where it accused a\n  // perfectly correct `--result-only` run of losing a witness that was never\n  // collected in the first place.\n  if (!ce_payload_requested)\n    return;\n\n  // Only a coordinate that is NOT an EVM environment value is expected in\n  // `inputs`; a box bounding only `msg.value` legitimately leaves it empty.\n  bool box_has_argument = false;\n  for (const auto &n : path_cov_certify_box_names)\n    if (\n      n.rfind(\"msg.\", 0) != 0 && n.rfind(\"tx.\", 0) != 0 &&\n      n.rfind(\"block.\", 0) != 0)\n      box_has_argument = true;\n  if (!box_has_argument)\n    return;\n\n  std::vector<std::string> witnessless;\n  {\n    std::lock_guard lock(claim_outcome_mutex);\n    for (const auto &key : all_claims)\n    {\n      const std::string sig = key.first + \"\\t\" + key.second;\n      auto v = claim_outcome.find(sig);\n      if (v == claim_outcome.end() || v->second != 'F')\n        continue; // not a refutation: nothing is owed\n      auto ce = path_ce.find(sig);\n      if (ce == path_ce.end() || ce->second.inputs.empty())\n        witnessless.push_back(key.first);\n    }\n  }\n  // ---- Turn the refutation into the NEXT BOX, not just a verdict ----\n  //\n  // The witness is an input inside the box that leaves the path, so the box has\n  // to be cut on the witness's side. Reported as \"not named\" when\n      // absent rather than skipped, because a coordinate the witness does not\n      // mention is exactly a coordinate the shrink cannot use.\n      auto witness_of =\n        [&](const std::string &coord, std::string &out) -> bool {\n        std::string env = coord, bare = coord;\n        for (auto &ch : env)\n          if (ch == '.')\n            ch = '_';\n        if (coord.rfind(\"state.\", 0) == 0)\n          bare = coord.substr(6);\n        for (const auto &[n, val] : ce->second.inputs)\n          if (n == coord || n == bare)\n          {\n            out = val;\n            return true;\n          }\n        for (const auto &[n, val] : ce->second.env)\n          if (n == env || n == coord)\n          {\n            out = val;\n            return true;\n          }\n        for (const auto &[n, val] : ce->second.entry_storage)\n          if (n == bare || n == coord)\n          {\n            out = val;\n            return true;\n          }\n        // ---- STRUCT FIELDS: `immutables.taker` under the key `immutables` ----\n        //\n        // The harvest stores a struct parameter ONCE, under its base name, as a\n        // pretty-printed aggregate. MEASURED on EscrowSrc.withdraw enc=6,\n        // whose witness differs on exactly ONE coordinate with an obviously\n        // legal cut: the run printed a bare VERIFICATION FAILED and no\n        // suggestion at all.\n        const size_t d = coord.find('.');\n        if (d != std::string::npos)\n        {\n          const std::string b0 = coord.substr(0, d), f0 = coord.substr(d + 1);\n          for (const auto &[n, val] : ce->second.inputs)\n          {\n            if (n != b0 || val.empty() || val[0] != '{')\n              continue;\n            // Depth-1 `.field=value` only, matching the driver's decomposition\n            // exactly: a nested aggregate's members belong to their own dotted\n            // name, and lifting one here would answer about a different\n            // quantity than the coordinate names.\n            int depth = 0;\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < val.size(); ++i)\n            {\n              if (val[i] == '{')\n                ++depth;\n              else if (val[i] == '}')\n                --depth;\n              else if (val[i] == '.' && depth == 1)\n              {\n                const size_t eq = val.find('=', i);\n                if (eq == std::string::npos)\n                  break;\n                if (val.substr(i + 1, eq - i - 1) == f0)\n                {\n                  size_t k = eq + 1;\n                  while (k < val.size() && val[k] != ',' && val[k] != '}')\n                    ++k;\n                  std::string v = val.substr(eq + 1, k - eq - 1);\n                  while (!v.empty() && v.front() == ' ')\n                    v.erase(v.begin());\n                  while (!v.empty() && v.back() == ' ')\n                    v.pop_back();\n                  // A nested aggregate or a non-value is not a witness value:\n                  // leaving it unmatched keeps the honest \"could not look it\n                  // up\" rather than inventing a number.\n                  if (!v.empty() && v[0] != '{' && v != \"nil\")\n                  {\n                    out = v;\n                    return true;\n                  }\n                }\n                i = eq;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        return false;\n      };\n      std::string best_coord, best_lo, best_hi;\n      BigInt best_width;\n      bool best = false, any_named = false;\n      // Coordinates on which the witness could be PUNCHED OUT instead of cut\n      // around (Definition 5). BigInt(s.c_str() + 2, 16)\n                   : string2integer(s);\n        };\n        const BigInt w = parse(wtxt), c = parse(cit->second);\n        const BigInt lo = string2integer(b[1]), hi = string2integer(b[2]);\n        if (w == c)\n          continue; // the witness agrees here: this coordinate cannot separate\n        // The witness is inside the box and outside the path; the path's own\n        // counterexample is inside the box and inside the path and differs here.\n        // So removing the single value `c == w` excludes the witness while\n        // keeping a known member of the domain — the same legality rule the side\n        // cuts obey, at a cost of ONE value instead of a side.\n        if (w >= lo && w <= hi)\n          punchable.push_back(b[0] + \" != \" + integer2string(w));\n        if (w > c)\n        {\n          const BigInt nhi = w - 1;\n          if (nhi >= lo && (!best || (nhi - lo) > best_width))\n          {\n            best = true;\n            best_coord = b[0];\n            best_lo = integer2string(lo);\n            best_hi = integer2string(nhi);\n            best_width = nhi - lo;\n          }\n        }\n        else\n        {\n          const BigInt nlo = w + 1;\n          if (nlo <= hi && (!best || (hi - nlo) > best_width))\n          {\n            best = true;\n            best_coord = b[0];\n            best_lo = integer2string(nlo);\n            best_hi = integer2string(hi);\n            best_width = hi - nlo;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      if (!punchable.empty())\n      {\n        std::string names;\n        for (const auto &p : punchable)\n          names += (names.empty() ? \"\" : \"; \") + p;\n        log_status(\n          \"--path-cov-certify: PUNCH SUGGESTION for '{}' — instead of cutting \"\n          \"the interval, remove the witness itself: add {} to the box's `holes` \"\n          \"(Definition 5). An aggregate has no\n// interval, so coord_expressible refuses it -- correctly -- and a unit whose\n// only real argument is a struct therefore had NOTHING to generalise over.\n// Measured across all five EscrowSrc units: every one reported zero\n// coordinates, with its actual argument sitting right there as a struct.\n//\n// It is NOT a new coordinate KIND and does not touch definition 6. Returning the\n// parent aggregate instead would hand the caller a coordinate it did not ask\n// for, and on the certify side that is a bound on the wrong quantity -- the one\n// outcome that query exists to prevent.\nstatic bool\nwalk_fields(const namespacet &ns, expr2tc &e, const std::string &path)\n{\n  size_t p = 0;\n  while (p <= path.size())\n  {\n    const size_t q = path.find('.', p);\n    const std::string field =\n      path.substr(p, q == std::string::npos ? q : q - p);\n    if (field.empty())\n      return false;\n    const typet st = ns.follow(migrate_type_back(e->type));\n    if (st.id() != \"struct\")\n      return false;\n    bool hit = false;\n    for (const auto &comp : to_struct_type(st).components())\n      if (comp.get_name() == field || comp.get(\"#base_name\") == field)\n      {\n        e = member2tc(migrate_type(comp.type()), e, comp.get_name());\n        hit = true;\n        break;\n      }\n    if (!hit)\n      return false;\n    if (q == std::string::npos)\n      return true;\n    p = q + 1;\n  }\n  return false;\n}\n\n// |R_c| for a punched interval (Definition 5): how many values of [lo, hi]\n// survive once this coordinate's holes are removed.\n//\n// Shared by the two places that must not disagree — the choice between a hole\n// and a side cut, and the test for whether the result is empty. If they used\n// separate arithmetic, a region could be chosen as the widest option and then\n// printed as non-empty while holding nothing.\nstatic BigInt path_cov_kept_in(\n  const std::map<std::string, std::set<BigInt>> &holes,\n  const std::string &c,\n  const BigInt &lo,\n  const BigInt &hi)\n{\n  if (hi < lo)\n    return BigInt(0);\n  BigInt n = hi - lo + 1;\n  auto h = holes.find(c);\n  if (h != holes.end())\n    for (const BigInt &v : h->second)\n      if (v >= lo && v <= hi)\n        n -= 1;\n  return n;\n}\n\nvoid goto_coveraget::report_outer_boxes()\n{\n  if (!path_cov_outer_box_mode)\n    return;\n\n  // ---- 1. Read the ladder verdicts ----\n  //\n  // A probe `assert(tr == pi -> temp_c <= v)` that HOLDS ('P') says every input\n  // walking pi has c <= v, so the tightest holding v is the outer bound. A\n  // refuted probe is not a failure — it is the ladder doing its job, and its\n  // counterexample is a real input of pi with c > v.\n  //\n  // Nothing here is \"proven unreachable\": these verdicts are bounded exactly\n  // like every other one in this pass, so an outer box is an outer box UNDER\n  // THE DECLARED EXPLORATION. A batch\n    // of K probes gives resolution span/(K+1) in one round; refining the next\n    // round's span to this bracket divides the resolution by (K+1) again, so the\n    // precision is logarithmic in ROUNDS while each round stays one run. Without\n    // the bracket a driver has no principled next span — and the recorded rule\n    // it would otherwise use (take the span from the nearest sibling\n    // counterexample) was measured NOT to work: a solver counterexample can sit\n    // arbitrarily far from the boundary, and on the first contract tried it sat\n    // at 2^256-1.\n    bool have_ur = false, have_lr = false;\n    BigInt ur, lr;\n  };\n  std::map<std::pair<uint64_t, std::string>, bound_infot> bounds;\n  // Seed with the free bound: the coordinate's own type range (see the header).\n  for (const auto &[enc, depth] : path_cov_outer_box_paths)\n    for (const auto &[cname, r] : path_cov_outer_box_type_range)\n    {\n      bound_infot &b = bounds[{enc, cname}];\n      b.have_l = b.have_u = true;\n      b.l = string2integer(r.first);\n      b.u = string2integer(r.second);\n    }\n  size_t decided = 0, undecided = 0;\n  {\n    std::lock_guard lock(claim_outcome_mutex);\n    for (const auto &p : path_cov_outer_box_probes)\n    {\n      auto it = claim_outcome.find(p.key.first + \"\\t\" + p.key.second);\n      if (it == claim_outcome.end())\n      {\n        ++undecided;\n        continue;\n      }\n      ++decided;\n      const BigInt v = string2integer(p.value);\n      bound_infot &b = bounds[{p.enc, p.coord}];\n      if (it->second == 'F')\n      {\n        // Refuted: keep the TIGHTEST one on each side, so the true bound is\n        // bracketed rather than merely upper-bounded.\n        if (p.upper)\n        {\n          if (!b.have_ur || v > b.ur)\n          {\n            b.ur = v;\n            b.have_ur = true;\n          }\n        }\n        else if (!b.have_lr || v < b.lr)\n        {\n          b.lr = v;\n          b.have_lr = true;\n        }\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (it->second != 'P')\n        continue; // unbounded there: cannot be used to separate on it\n        sbox[c] = {it->second.l, it->second.u};\n        auto ob = box.find(c);\n        if (ob == box.end())\n          continue;\n        if (it->second.u < ob->second.first || it->second.l > ob->second.second)\n          intersects = false;\n      }\n      if (!intersects)\n        continue; mask < pcombos; ++mask)\n1886\t        {\n1887\t          // Build the prefix witness for this direction mask, while\n1888\t          // tracking (stored-guard, polarity) pairs so we can drop mask\n1889\t          // combinations that are unsat by construction.\n1890\t          //\n1891\t          // ESBMC's `simplify` recognises 2-term `p ∧ ¬p` but does not\n1892\t          // fold chained forms like `p ∧ q ∧ ¬p` to FALSE — it would\n1893\t          // instrument a tautological `assert(¬(p ∧ q ∧ ¬p))` that can\n1894\t          // never be falsified, permanently inflating the denominator.\n1895\t          // Catching this at construction time is sound (we only drop\n1896\t          // witnesses we can prove unsat by syntactic structure) and\n1897\t          // preserves the single-term behaviour of the simplifier.\n1898\t          //\n1899\t          // Phase-1 limitation: this only catches *syntactic* same-atom\n1900\t          // contradictions (same stored guard with opposing polarities).\n1901\t          // Semantically contradictory pairs across different stored\n1902\t          // expressions — e.g. `(x == 1) ∧ (x == 2)` from successive\n1903\t          // switch-case branches — require comparison-domain reasoning\n1904\t          // and are out of scope for this PR.\n1905\t          expr2tc pwit;\n1906\t          std::vector<std::pair<expr2tc, bool>> atoms;\n1907\t          atoms.reserve(pdepth);\n1908\t          bool contradictory = false;\n1909\t          for (size_t i = 0; i < pdepth; ++i)\n1910\t          {\n1911\t            const bool pol = (mask & (size_t(1) << i)) != 0;\n1912\t            for (const auto &[h, p] : atoms)\n1913\t            {\n1914\t              if (h == active[i] && p != pol)\n1915\t              {\n1916\t                contradictory = true;\n1917\t                break;\n1918\t              }\n1919\t            }\n1920\t            if (contradictory)\n1921\t              break;\n1922\t            atoms.emplace_back(active[i], pol);\n1923\t            expr2tc d = pol ? active[i] : gen_not_expr(active[i]);\n1924\t            pwit = is_nil_expr(pwit) ? d : gen_and_expr(pwit, d);\n1925\t          }\n1926\t          if (contradictory)\n1927\t            continue;\n1928\t\n1929\t          // Emit one goal per current direction. Skip the direction if\n1930\t          // it would contradict an atom already in the prefix.\n1931\t          const expr2tc current_neg = gen_not_expr(current_guard);\n1932\t          for (size_t cd = 0; cd < 2; ++cd)\n1933\t          {\n1934\t            const bool cdir_pol = (cd == 0);\n1935\t            bool cdir_conflict = false;\n1936\t            for (const auto &[h, p] : atoms)\n1937\t            {\n1938\t              if (h == current_guard && p != cdir_pol)\n1939\t              {\n1940\t                cdir_conflict = true;\n1941\t                break;\n1942\t              }\n1943\t            }\n1944\t            if (cdir_conflict)\n1945\t              continue;\n1946\t\n1947\t            const expr2tc &cdir = cdir_pol ? current_guard : current_neg;\n1948\t            expr2tc full = is_nil_expr(pwit) ? cdir : gen_and_expr(pwit, cdir);\n1949\t            simplify(full);\n1950\t\n1951\t            if (is_false(full))\n1952\t              continue;\n1953\t            if (is_true(full))\n1954\t              continue;\n1955\t\n1956\t            if (expr_depth(full, k_path_witness_depth) > k_path_witness_depth)\n1957\t            {\n1958\t              // Phase 1: drop witnesses past the depth cap. The hashed\n1959\t              // ghost-flag fallback for deep prefixes is Phase 2 (#4325).\n1960\t              continue;\n1961\t            }\n1962\t\n1963\t            expr2tc neg_full = gen_not_expr(full);\n1964\t            simplify(neg_full);\n1965\t\n1966\t            std::string idf = from_expr(ns, \"\", full);\n1967\t            insert_assert(goto_program, it, neg_full, idf);\n1968\t\n1969\t            // Record the goal's full atom multiset (prefix + current\n1970\t            // direction) so the spanning-set analysis can drop subsumed\n1971\t            // emissions from the coverage denominator.\n1972\t            std::vector<std::pair<expr2tc, bool>> goal_atoms = atoms;\n1973\t            goal_atoms.emplace_back(current_guard, cdir_pol);\n1974\t            spanning.add_goal(\n1975\t              std::move(goal_atoms), idf, it->location.as_string());\n1976\t\n1977\t            ++function_goals;\n1978\t          }\n1979\t        }\n1980\t\n1981\t        prefix.push_back(current_guard);\n1982\t        if (prefix.size() > k_path_n - 1)\n1983\t          prefix.pop_front();\n1984\t      }\n1985\t    }\n1986\t  }\n1987\t\n1988\t  total_kpath = get_total_instrument();\n1989\t  all_claims = get_total_cond_assert();\n1990\t\n1991\t  // Soundness invariant: each insert_assert call above paired with\n1992\t  // exactly one spanning.add_goal call, so the number of goals tracked\n1993\t  // in the spanning analysis must equal the number of instrumented\n1994\t  // assertions counted in the goto programs. A divergence means the\n1995\t  // emission path diverged from the spanning bookkeeping (e.g. a future\n1996\t  // edit added an insert_assert without the matching add_goal, or vice\n1997\t  // versa) and the spanning-set denominator would be silently wrong.\n1998\t  // ESBMC is a verifier — we abort rather than report an unsound\n1999\t  // coverage percentage.\n2000\t  if (spanning.total() != static_cast<size_t>(total_kpath))\n2001\t  {\n2002\t    log_error(\n2003\t      \"k-path coverage: internal invariant violated — spanning.total()={} \"\n2004\t      \"but get_total_instrument()={}. Each instrumented assertion must \"\n2005\t      \"have a matching spanning.add_goal entry. Aborting rather than \"\n2006\t      \"report an unsound coverage percentage.\",\n2007\t      spanning.total(),\n2008\t      total_kpath);\n2009\t    abort();\n2010\t  }\n2011\t\n2012\t  // Compute the spanning-set after every goal has been collected. The\n2013\t  // resulting size is the Phase-2 denominator; redundant_claims feeds the\n2014\t  // JSON `feasibility` field.\n2015\t  //\n2016\t  // Secondary invariant: the simplifier never collapses two semantically\n2017\t  // distinct witnesses to the same idf string, so spanning_size_ is\n2018\t  // bounded above by all_claims.size() + |redundant|, which is what\n2019\t  // allows the bmc.cpp coverage cap to make sense. Any future change\n2020\t  // that reuses an idf across distinct witnesses or alters from_expr()\n2021\t  // formatting must preserve this 1:1 mapping or the percentage will\n2022\t  // silently deflate.\n2023\t  spanning.finalize();\n2024\t  total_kpath_spanning = spanning.spanning_size();\n2025\t  for (const auto &claim : all_claims)\n2026\t    if (spanning.is_redundant(claim.first, claim.second))\n2027\t      k_path_spanning_redundant.insert(claim);\n2028\t\n2029\t  goto_functions.update();\n2030\t}\n2031\t\n2032\t// Count complete paths in a goto program WITHOUT instrumenting it, using the\n2033\t// same traversal rules as the enumerating DFS: conditional GOTOs fan out 2-way,\n2034\t// each loop head gets its own back-edge budget, folded short-circuit operands in\n2035\t// ASSIGN/RETURN fan out 2^K, and RETURN / END_FUNCTION / a `#sol_error` call are\n2036\t// terminators.\n2037\t//\n2038\t// Sole purpose is measurement: it is run on a snapshot of each unit's body taken\n2039\t// BEFORE internal calls are expanded, so the ratio against the real enumeration\n2040\t// quantifies how much expansion multiplies paths — a cost that was declared when\n2041\t// expansion was adopted and until now had no number attached.\n2042\t//\n2043\t// Duplicated traversal logic is a drift hazard, so the caller checks the one\n2044\t// case where the two must agree exactly: a unit into which nothing was expanded\n2045\t// must produce the same count from both. A mismatch there is a hard failure, so\n2046\t// this measurement is itself measured rather than self-certified.\n2047\tstatic size_t count_paths_no_instrument(\n2048\t  const goto_programt &p,\n2049\t  const namespacet &ns,\n2050\t  size_t unwind,\n2051\t  size_t cap,\n2052\t  bool &hit_cap)\n2053\t{\n2054\t  hit_cap = false;\n2055\t  if (p.instructions.empty())\n2056\t    return 0;\n2057\t\n2058\t  auto is_err_call = [&ns](goto_programt::const_targett i) {\n2059\t    if (!i->is_function_call() || !is_code_function_call2t(i->code))\n2060\t      return false;\n2061\t    const expr2tc &fn = to_code_function_call2t(i->code).function;\n2062\t    if (!is_symbol2t(fn))\n2063\t      return false;\n2064\t    const symbolt *s = ns.lookup(to_symbol2t(fn).thename);\n2065\t    return s && !s->type.get(\"#sol_error\").as_string().empty();\n2066\t  };\n2067\t\n2068\t  using becntt = std::map<unsigned, unsigned>;\n2069\t  std::vector<std::pair<goto_programt::const_targett, becntt>> stack;\n2070\t  stack.push_back({p.instructions.begin(), becntt{}});\n2071\t  size_t paths = 0, pushes = 0;\n2072\t  const size_t push_cap = 50 * cap + 100000;\n2073\t\n2074\t  while (!stack.empty())\n2075\t  {\n2076\t    auto [pc, becnt] = stack.back();\n2077\t    stack.pop_back();\n2078\t    while (true)\n2079\t    {\n2080\t      if (pc == p.instructions.end() || pc->is_end_function())\n2081\t      {\n2082\t        if (pc != p.instructions.end())\n2083\t          ++paths;\n2084\t        break;\n2085\t      }\n2086\t      if (is_err_call(pc))\n2087\t      {\n2088\t        ++paths;\n2089\t        break;\n2090\t      }\n2091\t      if (pc->is_return() && is_code_return2t(pc->code))\n2092\t      {\n2093\t        size_t rk = 0;\n2094\t        if (pc->location.property().as_string() != \"skipped\")\n2095\t          collect_short_circuit_decisions(\n2096\t            to_code_return2t(pc->code).operand,\n2097\t            [&](const expr2tc &) { ++rk; });\n2098\t        paths += (rk > 0 && rk <= SC_DECISION_MAX) ? (size_t(1) << rk) : 1;\n2099\t        break;\n2100\t      }\n2101\t      if (pc->is_goto())\n2102\t      {\n2103\t        const bool back = pc->is_backwards_goto();\n2104\t        if (is_true(pc->guard))\n2105\t        {\n2106\t          if (back)\n2107\t          {\n2108\t            const unsigned key = pc->get_target()->target_number;\n2109\t            if (becnt[key] >= unwind)\n2110\t              break;\n2111\t            ++becnt[key];\n2112\t          }\n2113\t          pc = pc->get_target();\n2114\t          continue;\n2115\t        }\n2116\t        bool take = true;\n2117\t        becntt becnt_taken = becnt;\n2118\t        if (back)\n2119\t        {\n2120\t          const unsigned key = pc->get_target()->target_number;\n2121\t          if (becnt_taken[key] >= unwind)\n2122\t            take = false;\n2123\t          else\n2124\t            ++becnt_taken[key];\n2125\t        }\n2126\t        if (take)\n2127\t        {\n2128\t          if (++pushes > push_cap)\n2129\t          {\n2130\t            hit_cap = true;\n2131\t            break;\n2132\t          }\n2133\t          stack.push_back({pc->get_target(), becnt_taken});\n2134\t        }\n2135\t        pc = std::next(pc);\n2136\t        continue;\n2137\t      }\n2138\t      if (pc->is_assign() && pc->location.property().as_string() != \"skipped\")\n2139\t      {\n2140\t        size_t k = 0;\n2141\t        collect_short_circuit_decisions(\n2142\t          to_code_assign2t(pc->code).source, [&](const expr2tc &) { ++k; });\n2143\t        if (k > 0 && k <= SC_DECISION_MAX)\n2144\t        {\n2145\t          for (uint64_t m = 0; m < (uint64_t(1) << k); ++m)\n2146\t          {\n2147\t            if (++pushes > push_cap)\n2148\t            {\n2149\t              hit_cap = true;\n2150\t              break;\n2151\t            }\n2152\t            stack.push_back({std::next(pc), becnt});\n2153\t          }\n2154\t          break;\n2155\t        }\n2156\t      }\n2157\t      pc = std::next(pc);\n2158\t    }\n2159\t    if (paths > cap)\n2160\t    {\n2161\t      hit_cap = true;\n2162\t      break;\n2163\t    }\n2164\t    if (hit_cap)\n2165\t      break;\n2166\t  }\n2167\t  return paths;\n2168\t}\n2169\t\n2170\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n2171\t// Selective inliner for Solidity complete-path coverage.\n2172\t//\n2173\t// The methodology fixes two separate things that are easy to conflate:\n2174\t//   * what is a UNIT (does it get a path set of its own)? -> a public/external\n2175\t//     function, because that is what an external caller can invoke;\n2176\t//   * does a CALL expand into the caller's path identity? -> an internal call\n2177\t//     expands, an external call does not (its success/failure is the branch\n2178\t//     point instead).\n2179\t// The two answers are independent: a `public` function that is also called\n2180\t// internally is BOTH a unit of its own (entered from outside, free arguments)\n2181\t// AND expanded into its internal caller's paths (entered with computed\n2182\t// arguments). Both descriptions are needed and they describe different input\n2183\t// spaces.\n2184\t//\n2185\t// Expansion must be PHYSICAL — splice the callee's body into the caller —\n2186\t// rather than a cross-function walk of the enumerator, because `tr`/`cnt` are\n2187\t// per-function ghost symbols: a callee left as a call updates ITS OWN\n2188\t// accumulator, so its decisions are invisible to the caller's path number.\n2189\t// Splicing first and instrumenting second makes the caller's own accumulator\n2190\t// record the whole expanded decision sequence, with no shared-state bookkeeping.\n2191\t//\n2192\t// goto_inlinet's own inliners cannot be used directly: `full` inlining drags in\n2193\t// every c2goto library model, and its recursion handling rewrites the recursive\n2194\t// call to a SKIP — deleting a real behaviour instead of bounding it. So the\n2195\t// call-selection policy and the recursion bound live here, and only the tested\n2196\t// mechanical pieces (parameter_assignments / replace_return) are reused.\n2197\tclass sol_path_inlinet : public goto_inlinet\n2198\t{\n2199\tpublic:\n2200\t  sol_path_inlinet(\n2201\t    goto_functionst &_goto_functions,\n2202\t    optionst &_options,\n2203\t    const namespacet &_ns)\n2204\t    : goto_inlinet(_goto_functions, _options, _ns)\n2205\t  {\n2206\t  }\n2207\t\n2208\t  // Splice `f`'s body over the FUNCTION_CALL at `target`. On return `target`\n2209\t  // names the instruction FOLLOWING the spliced region, so a single pass\n2210\t  // expands exactly the calls that were present when the pass began — that is\n2211\t  // what makes \"one pass == one level of call depth\" true, and hence what\n2212\t  // bounds recursion.\n2213\t  void expand_here(\n2214\t    goto_programt &dest,\n2215\t    goto_programt::targett &target,\n2216\t    const goto_functiont &f)\n2217\t  {\n2218\t    // Copy what we need out of the call before the instruction is overwritten.\n2219\t    const code_function_call2t &call = to_code_function_call2t(target->code);\n2220\t    const expr2tc lhs = call.ret;\n2221\t    const std::vector<expr2tc> args = call.operands;\n2222\t\n2223\t    goto_programt tmp2;\n2224\t    tmp2.copy_from(f.body);\n2225\t    assert(tmp2.instructions.back().is_end_function());\n2226\t    tmp2.instructions.back().type = LOCATION;\n2227\t    replace_return(tmp2, lhs);\n2228\t\n2229\t    goto_programt tmp;\n2230\t    parameter_assignments(\n2231\t      tmp2.instructions.front().location, f.type, args, tmp);\n2232\t    // parameter_assignments emits each formal as an OTHER instruction carrying\n2233\t    // a code_decl. goto_symext::symex_other has no case for code_decl and\n2234\t    // aborts the run (\"unexpected statement: code_decl\") — measured. The\n2235\t    // existing inliners get away with it only because they run before the pass\n2236\t    // that normalises this; we run after goto conversion, so emit the real\n2237\t    // instruction kind.\n2238\t    Forall_goto_program_instructions (pit, tmp)\n2239\t      if (pit->type == OTHER && !is_nil_expr(pit->code) &&\n2240\t          is_code_decl2t(pit->code))\n2241\t        pit->type = DECL;\n2242\t    tmp.destructive_append(tmp2);\n2243\t\n2244\t    // Flag every spliced instruction. The exit classifier asks \"did this path\n2245\t    // run the function epilogue?\" via a symbol name that an inlined callee's\n2246\t    // own epilogue also matches; without the flag, a caller's bare revert edge\n2247\t    // that happened to walk through an inlined callee's epilogue would be\n2248\t    // reported `normal` instead of `undetermined`.\n2249\t    Forall_goto_program_instructions (iit, tmp)\n2250\t      iit->location.set(\"sol_path_inlined\", true);\n2251\t\n2252\t    target->type = LOCATION;\n2253\t    target->code = expr2tc();\n2254\t    goto_programt::targett next_target(target);\n2255\t    ++next_target;\n2256\t    dest.instructions.splice(next_target, tmp.instructions);\n2257\t    target = next_target;\n2258\t  }\n2259\t};\n2260\t\n2261\t// ---- Can a box bound be EXPRESSED on this coordinate? ----\n2262\t//\n2263\t// A WHITELIST, deliberately, and the direction is the whole point. Resolving a\n2264\t// coordinate name succeeds for plenty of things this stage cannot bound: a\n2265\t// `string` state variable, a contract/interface handle, a struct. Every bound\n2266\t// is built as `coord <= constant` / `coord >= constant` with the constant\n2267\t// carrying the coordinate's own type, so a non-integer coordinate produces a\n2268\t// malformed comparison that the SMT layer then dies on — measured as\n2269\t// \"Projecting from non-tuple based AST\" and as a \"Tuple AST mismatch\"\n2270\t// assertion, both SIGABRT. An abort turns a recordable refusal into a core\n2271\t// dump, which unattended is the difference between a datum and a lost run.\n2272\t//\n2273\t// So the test is \"is it one of the kinds we can bound?\" and NOT \"is it one of\n2274\t// the kinds we know to be broken\". Unrecognised types are unbounded in number:\n2275\t// three projects fell over on three DIFFERENT ones (mapping, string, calldata\n2276\t// struct) with the identical failure shape, and a blacklist would have caught\n2277\t// at most the one that was written down. A new bounded type is one line here;\n2278\t// a new unbounded type costs a named refusal, not a crash.\n2279\t//\n2280\t// Bit-vectors only. Address, bytesN and every Solidity integer lower to one, so\n2281\t// this covers the coordinates that have ever been measured. `bool` is left OUT\n2282\t// on purpose rather than by oversight: a two-point domain has no interval to\n2283\t// measure, and the honest shape for it is an equality coordinate, which this\n2284\t// stage does not have. Refusing it names it instead of bounding it wrongly.\n2285\tstatic bool\n2286\tcoord_expressible(const type2tc &t, std::string &why)\n2287\t{\n2288\t  if (is_unsignedbv_type(t))\n2289\t    return true;\n2290\t  // SIGNED IS REFUSED, and it was NOT before. Letting it in was my own hole and\n2291\t  // it is a live false certificate, reproduced on a must-flip pair that differs\n2292\t  // in one token:\n2293\t  //\n2294\t  //   uint256 a, box a in [0, 2^256-1]  ->  VERIFICATION FAILED   (correct: the\n2295\t  //                                        box is the whole type and holds\n2296\t  //                                        inputs of both paths)\n2297\t  //   int256  a, the SAME decimal box   ->  VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL\n2298\t  //\n2299\t  // Because the bound is built with constant_int2tc on the coordinate's own\n2300\t  // type and the comparison is signedness-aware: on a signed 256-bit type the\n2301\t  // decimal 2^256-1 is all ones, i.e. -1 under bvsle, so `a >= 0 && a <= -1` is\n2302\t  // UNSATISFIABLE and every exit assert holds for want of an execution.\n2303\t  //\n2304\t  // Note what this defeats: the empty-box guard added hours earlier compares the\n2305\t  // spec's DECIMAL lo and hi, and 0 <= 2^256-1 decimally, so it never fires. The\n2306\t  // box is empty in the SOLVER and non-empty in the SPEC -- exactly the gap\n2307\t  // between the two readings that the guard was written without considering.\n2308\t  //\n2309\t  // Refusing is the fail-closed direction and costs nothing measured: every\n2310\t  // coordinate any real contract has produced so far is uint256, address or\n2311\t  // bytesN, all unsigned. Supporting signed properly is not a whitelist entry,\n2312\t  // it is bound VALIDATION -- the spec's decimal bounds have to be checked\n2313\t  // against the coordinate's own signed range ([-2^255, 2^255-1] for int256)\n2314\t  // and refused when out of it. That is a separate change with its own criteria;\n2315\t  // it must not be smuggled in by widening this test back.\n2316\t  if (is_signedbv_type(t))\n2317\t    why = \"it resolves to a SIGNED bit-vector. A bound is built as a constant \"\n2318\t          \"of the coordinate's own type and compared with a signedness-aware \"\n2319\t          \"predicate, so a decimal bound above the signed maximum wraps to a \"\n2320\t          \"negative value and can make the assumption UNSATISFIABLE -- which \"\n2321\t          \"certifies vacuously while the printed box still looks non-empty \"\n2322\t          \"(reproduced: the same box that is refuted on uint256 is 'certified' \"\n2323\t          \"on int256). Supporting this needs the bounds validated against the \"\n2324\t          \"signed range, not a wider type test\";\n2325\t  else if (is_array_type(t))\n2326\t    why = \"it resolves to an ARRAY — the frontend lowers strings, bytes, \"\n2327\t          \"mappings and dynamic arrays to arrays, and a scalar interval is not \"\n2328\t          \"expressible on one\";\n2329\t  else if (is_struct_type(t) || is_union_type(t))\n2330\t    why = \"it resolves to an AGGREGATE (struct / contract instance) — bounding \"\n2331\t          \"it would need a coordinate per field, which is a different \"\n2332\t          \"coordinate kind, not a wider interval\";\n2333\t  else if (is_pointer_type(t))\n2334\t    why = \"it resolves to a POINTER (a contract or interface handle) — the \"\n2335\t          \"value is an address in the model's own allocator, not an input a \"\n2336\t          \"test can set\";\n2337\t  else if (is_bool_type(t))\n2338\t    why = \"it resolves to a BOOLEAN — a two-point domain has no interval to \"\n2339\t          \"measure; the honest shape is an equality coordinate, which this \"\n2340\t          \"stage does not have\";\n2341\t  else\n2342\t    why = \"it does not resolve to a bit-vector, which is the only kind this \"\n2343\t          \"stage can put a bound on\";\n2344\t  return false;\n2345\t}\n2346\t\n2347\t/*\n2348\tSolidity complete-path coverage (entry->exit path coverage for test gen).\n2349\t\n2350\tThe UNIT is a public/external function — what an external caller can actually\n2351\tinvoke. Internal/private helpers are not units: an internal call is EXPANDED\n2352\tinto its caller (see sol_path_inlinet above), so the callee's decisions are part\n2353\tof the caller's path identity, and the helper gets no path set of its own. A\n2354\t`public` function that is also called internally is therefore described twice,\n2355\tby design: once as a unit entered from outside with free arguments, and once as\n2356\texpanded decisions inside each internal caller's paths, where its arguments are\n2357\tcomputed. k_path_spanning_redundant.clear();\n  k_path_spanning_sett spanning;\n\n  // Defense-in-depth: parseoptions rejects N==0 and N>30 at the CLI, but\n  // re-check here in case the method is invoked via // Reset per function: each function is its own k-path scope (#4325).\n    std::deque<expr2tc> prefix;\n    size_t function_goals = 0;\n\n    Forall_goto_program_instructions (it, goto_program)\n    {\n      std::string cur_filename =\n        get_filename_from_path(it->location.file().as_string());\n      if (location_pool.count(cur_filename) == 0)\n        continue;\n\n      if A divergence means the\n  // emission path diverged from the spanning bookkeeping (e.g. a future\n  // edit added an insert_assert without the matching add_goal, or vice\n  // versa) and the spanning-set denominator would be silently wrong.\n  // ESBMC is a verifier — we abort rather than report an unsound\n  // coverage percentage.\n  if (spanning.total() != static_cast<size_t>(total_kpath))\n  {\n    log_error(\n      \"k-path coverage: internal invariant violated — spanning.total()={} \"\n      \"but get_total_instrument()={}. Aborting rather than \"\n      \"report an unsound coverage percentage.\",\n      spanning.total(),\n      total_kpath);\n    abort();\n  }\n\n  // Compute the spanning-set after every goal has been collected. A mismatch there is a hard failure, so\n// this measurement is itself measured rather than self-certified.\nstatic size_t count_paths_no_instrument(\n  const goto_programt &p,\n  const namespacet &ns,\n  size_t unwind,\n  size_t cap,\n  bool &hit_cap)\n{\n  hit_cap = false;\n  if (p.instructions.empty())\n    return 0;\n\n  auto is_err_call = [&ns](goto_programt::const_targett i) {\n    if (!i->is_function_call() || !is_code_function_call2t(i->code))\n      return false;\n    const expr2tc &fn = to_code_function_call2t(i->code).function;\n    if (!is_symbol2t(fn))\n      return false;\n    const symbolt *s = ns.lookup(to_symbol2t(fn).thename);\n    return s && !s->type.get(\"#sol_error\").as_string().empty();\n  };\n\n  using becntt = std::map<unsigned, unsigned>;\n  std::vector<std::pair<goto_programt::const_targett, becntt>> stack;\n  stack.push_back({p.instructions.begin(), becntt{}});\n  size_t paths = 0, pushes = 0;\n  const size_t push_cap = 50 * cap + 100000;\n\n  while (!stack.empty())\n  {\n    auto [pc, becnt] = stack.back();\n    stack.pop_back();\n    while (true)\n    {\n      if (pc == p.instructions.end() || pc->is_end_function())\n      {\n        if (pc != p.instructions.end())\n          ++paths;\n        break;\n      }\n      if (is_err_call(pc))\n      {\n        ++paths;\n        break;\n      }\n      if (pc->is_return() && is_code_return2t(pc->code))\n      {\n        size_t rk = 0;\n        if (pc->location.property().as_string() != \"skipped\")\n          collect_short_circuit_decisions(\n            to_code_return2t(pc->code).operand,\n            [&](const expr2tc &) { ++rk; });\n        paths += (rk > 0 && rk <= SC_DECISION_MAX) ? (size_t(1) << rk) : 1;\n        break;\n      }\n      if (pc->is_goto())\n      {\n        const bool back = pc->is_backwards_goto();\n        if (is_true(pc->guard))\n        {\n          if (back)\n          {\n            const unsigned key = pc->get_target()->target_number;\n            if (becnt[key] >= unwind)\n              break;\n            ++becnt[key];\n          }\n          pc = pc->get_target();\n          continue;\n        }\n        bool take = true;\n        becntt becnt_taken = becnt;\n        if (back)\n        {\n          const unsigned key = pc->get_target()->target_number;\n          if (becnt_taken[key] >= unwind)\n            take = false;\n          else\n            ++becnt_taken[key];\n        }\n        if (take)\n        {\n          if (++pushes > push_cap)\n          {\n            hit_cap = true;\n            break;\n          }\n          stack.push_back({pc->get_target(), becnt_taken});\n        }\n        pc = std::next(pc);\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (pc->is_assign() && pc->location.property().as_string() != \"skipped\")\n      {\n        size_t k = 0;\n        collect_short_circuit_decisions(\n          to_code_assign2t(pc->code).source, [&](const expr2tc &) { ++k; });\n        if (k > 0 && k <= SC_DECISION_MAX)\n        {\n          for (uint64_t m = 0; m < (uint64_t(1) << k); ++m)\n          {\n            if (++pushes > push_cap)\n            {\n              hit_cap = true;\n              break;\n            }\n            stack.push_back({std::next(pc), becnt});\n          }\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n      pc = std::next(pc);\n    }\n    if (paths > cap)\n    {\n      hit_cap = true;\n      break;\n    }\n    if (hit_cap)\n      break;\n  }\n  return paths;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Selective inliner for Solidity complete-path coverage.\n//\n// The methodology fixes two separate things that are easy to conflate:\n//   * what is a UNIT (does it get a path set of its own)? -> a public/external\n//     function, because that is what an external caller can invoke;\n//   * does a CALL expand into the caller's path identity? -> an internal call\n//     expands, an external call does not (its success/failure is the branch\n//     point instead).\n// The two answers are independent: a `public` function that is also called\n// internally is BOTH a unit of its own (entered from outside, free arguments)\n// AND expanded into its internal caller's paths (entered with computed\n// arguments). Both descriptions are needed and they describe different input\n// spaces.\n//\n// Expansion must be PHYSICAL — splice the callee's body into the caller —\n// rather than a cross-function walk of the enumerator, because `tr`/`cnt` are\n// per-function ghost symbols: a callee left as a call updates ITS OWN\n// accumulator, so its decisions are invisible to the caller's path number.\n// Splicing first and instrumenting second makes the caller's own accumulator\n// record the whole expanded decision sequence, with no shared-state bookkeeping.\n//\n// goto_inlinet's own inliners cannot be used directly: `full` inlining drags in\n// every c2goto library model, and its recursion handling rewrites the recursive\n// call to a SKIP — deleting a real behaviour instead of bounding it. So the\n// call-selection policy and the recursion bound live here, and only the tested\n// mechanical pieces (parameter_assignments / replace_return) are reused.\nclass sol_path_inlinet : public goto_inlinet\n{\npublic:\n  sol_path_inlinet(\n    goto_functionst &_goto_functions,\n    optionst &_options,\n    const namespacet &_ns)\n    : goto_inlinet(_goto_functions, _options, _ns)\n  {\n  }\n\n  // Splice `f`'s body over the FUNCTION_CALL at `target`. On return `target`\n  // names the instruction FOLLOWING the spliced region, so a single pass\n  // expands exactly the calls that were present when the pass began — that is\n  // what makes \"one pass == one level of call depth\" true, and hence what\n  // bounds recursion.\n  void expand_here(\n    goto_programt &dest,\n    goto_programt::targett &target,\n    const goto_functiont &f)\n  {\n    // Copy what we need out of the call before the instruction is overwritten.\n    const code_function_call2t &call = to_code_function_call2t(target->code);\n    const expr2tc lhs = call.ret;\n    const std::vector<expr2tc> args = call.operands;\n\n    goto_programt tmp2;\n    tmp2.copy_from(f.body);\n    assert(tmp2.instructions.back().is_end_function());\n    tmp2.instructions.back().type = LOCATION;\n    replace_return(tmp2, lhs);\n\n    goto_programt tmp;\n    parameter_assignments(\n      tmp2.instructions.front().location, f.type, args, tmp);\n    // parameter_assignments emits each formal as an OTHER instruction carrying\n    // a code_decl. goto_symext::symex_other has no case for code_decl and\n    // aborts the run (\"unexpected statement: code_decl\") — measured. The\n    // existing inliners get away with it only because they run before the pass\n    // that normalises this; we run after goto conversion, so emit the real\n    // instruction kind.\n    Forall_goto_program_instructions (pit, tmp)\n      if (pit->type == OTHER && !is_nil_expr(pit->code) &&\n          is_code_decl2t(pit->code))\n        pit->type = DECL;\n    tmp.destructive_append(tmp2);\n\n    // Flag every spliced instruction. The exit classifier asks \"did this path\n    // run the function epilogue?\" via a symbol name that an inlined callee's\n    // own epilogue also matches; without the flag, a caller's bare revert edge\n    // that happened to walk through an inlined callee's epilogue would be\n    // reported `normal` instead of `undetermined`.\n    Forall_goto_program_instructions (iit, tmp)\n      iit->location.set(\"sol_path_inlined\", true);\n\n    target->type = LOCATION;\n    target->code = expr2tc();\n    goto_programt::targett next_target(target);\n    ++next_target;\n    dest.instructions.splice(next_target, tmp.instructions);\n    target = next_target;\n  }\n};\n\n// ---- Can a box bound be EXPRESSED on this coordinate? ----\n//\n// A WHITELIST, deliberately, and the direction is the whole point. Resolving a\n// coordinate name succeeds for plenty of things this stage cannot bound: a\n// `string` state variable, a contract/interface handle, a struct. Every bound\n// is built as `coord <= constant` / `coord >= constant` with the constant\n// carrying the coordinate's own type, so a non-integer coordinate produces a\n// malformed comparison that the SMT layer then dies on — measured as\n// \"Projecting from non-tuple based AST\" and as a \"Tuple AST mismatch\"\n// assertion, both SIGABRT. An abort turns a recordable refusal into a core\n// dump, which unattended is the difference between a datum and a lost run.\n//\n// So the test is \"is it one of the kinds we can bound?\" and NOT \"is it one of\n// the kinds we know to be broken\". A new bounded type is one line here;\n// a new unbounded type costs a named refusal, not a crash.\n//\n// Bit-vectors only. Address, bytesN and every Solidity integer lower to one, so\n// this covers the coordinates that have ever been measured. `bool` is left OUT\n// on purpose rather than by oversight: a two-point domain has no interval to\n// measure, and the honest shape for it is an equality coordinate, which this\n// stage does not have. Refusing it names it instead of bounding it wrongly.\nstatic bool\ncoord_expressible(const type2tc &t, std::string &why)\n{\n  if (is_unsignedbv_type(t))\n    return true;\n  // SIGNED IS REFUSED, and it was NOT before. Letting it in was my own hole and\n  // it is a live false certificate, reproduced on a must-flip pair that differs\n  // in one token:\n  //\n  //   uint256 a, box a in [0, 2^256-1]  ->  VERIFICATION FAILED   (correct: the\n  //                                        box is the whole type and holds\n  //                                        inputs of both paths)\n  //   int256  a, the SAME decimal box   ->  VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL\n  //\n  // Because the bound is built with constant_int2tc on the coordinate's own\n  // type and the comparison is signedness-aware: on a signed 256-bit type the\n  // decimal 2^256-1 is all ones, i.e. -1 under bvsle, so `a >= 0 && a <= -1` is\n  // UNSATISFIABLE and every exit assert holds for want of an execution.\n  //\n  // Note what this defeats: the empty-box guard added hours earlier compares the\n  // spec's DECIMAL lo and hi, and 0 <= 2^256-1 decimally, so it never fires. The\n  // box is empty in the SOLVER and non-empty in the SPEC -- exactly the gap\n  // between the two readings that the guard was written without considering.\n  //\n  // Refusing is the fail-closed direction and costs nothing measured: every\n  // coordinate any real contract has produced so far is uint256, address or\n  // bytesN, all unsigned. Supporting signed properly is not a whitelist entry,\n  // it is bound VALIDATION -- the spec's decimal bounds have to be checked\n  // against the coordinate's own signed range ([-2^255, 2^255-1] for int256)\n  // and refused when out of it. That is a separate change with its own criteria;\n  // it must not be smuggled in by widening this test back.\n  if (is_signedbv_type(t))\n    why = \"it resolves to a SIGNED bit-vector. A bound is built as a constant \"\n          \"of the coordinate's own type and compared with a signedness-aware \"\n          \"predicate, so a decimal bound above the signed maximum wraps to a \"\n          \"negative value and can make the assumption UNSATISFIABLE -- which \"\n          \"certifies vacuously while the printed box still looks non-empty \"\n          \"(reproduced: the same box that is refuted on uint256 is 'certified' \"\n          \"on int256). Supporting this needs the bounds validated against the \"\n          \"signed range, not a wider type test\";\n  else if (is_array_type(t))\n    why = \"it resolves to an ARRAY — the frontend lowers strings, bytes, \"\n          \"mappings and dynamic arrays to arrays, and a scalar interval is not \"\n          \"expressible on one\";\n  else if (is_struct_type(t) || is_union_type(t))\n    why = \"it resolves to an AGGREGATE (struct / contract instance) — bounding \"\n          \"it would need a coordinate per field, which is a different \"\n          \"coordinate kind, not a wider interval\";\n  else if (is_pointer_type(t))\n    why = \"it resolves to a POINTER (a contract or interface handle) — the \"\n          \"value is an address in the model's own allocator, not an input a \"\n          \"test can set\";\n  else if (is_bool_type(t))\n    why = \"it resolves to a BOOLEAN — a two-point domain has no interval to \"\n          \"measure; the honest shape is an equality coordinate, which this \"\n          \"stage does not have\";\n  else\n    why = \"it does not resolve to a bit-vector, which is the only kind this \"\n          \"stage can put a bound on\";\n  return false;\n}\n\n/*\nSolidity complete-path coverage (entry->exit path coverage for test gen).\n\nThe UNIT is a public/external function — what an external caller can actually\ninvoke. Internal/private helpers are not units: an internal call is EXPANDED\ninto its caller (see sol_path_inlinet above), so the callee's decisions are part\nof the caller's path identity, and the helper gets no path set of its own. A\n`public` function that is also called internally is therefore described twice,\nby design: once as a unit entered from outside with free arguments, and once as\nexpanded decisions inside each internal caller's paths, where its arguments are\ncomputed. Those are different input spaces and need different tests.\n\nConsequence for reading the totals: the same source line can appear in more than\none unit's path set, so the path total is NOT a count of distinct code paths in\nthe contract — it is the sum over units of that unit's complete paths.\n\nFor each unit:\n  Phase 1: one integer path-number accumulator `tr`. At function entry\n           `tr = 1`; before every decision `tr = tr*2 + guard_value`. A single\n           scalar records the whole decision sequence in order and survives\n           loop unrolling (symex re-runs the update each iteration), so it\n           handles loops without per-occurrence ghost symbols. The guard VALUE\n           (not the direction) is accumulated; the path condition supplies the\n           direction, so no CFG edge-splitting is needed.\n  Phase 2: bounded DFS of complete entry->exit decision sequences. Each path's\n           number enc mirrors tr (start 1; enc*2+1 for the guard-true/taken\n           successor, enc*2+0 for guard-false/fallthrough). So every contract-state write and every environment\n2766\t  // read is unreachable from the claim and gets sliced, leaving the report's\n2767\t  // `inputs`/`env`/`final_state` empty. (Call arguments survive on their own:\n2768\t  // the decisions that build `tr` are guards over them.)\n2769\t  //\n2770\t  // ESBMC already has a per-symbol exemption for exactly this — no_slice_names\n2771\t  // (`--no-slice-name`), consulted by symex_slicet::get_symbols. Register the\n2772\t  // three symbol families the harvest in bmc.cpp reads, and nothing else:\n2773\t  //   (a) the contract instance object — a Solidity `this->x = v` is an update\n2774\t  //       of THIS symbol, so without it every final_state is empty;\n2775\t  //   (b) contract-scope stores with no `@F@` in the id — mappings and dynamic\n2776\t  //       arrays are NOT fields of the contract object, the frontend lowers\n2777\t  //       them to contract-level globals; this is the same shape the harvest\n2778\t  //       keys on;\n2779\t  //   (c) the EVM environment, by the same msg_/tx_/block_ base-name test the\n2780\t  //       harvest uses to classify a value as `env` rather than an argument.\n2781\t  // Everything else — the c2goto keccak/sha256/ABI tables, the address\n2782\t  // allocator, the dispatcher plumbing — is still sliced away.\n2783\t  if (protect_ce_symbols)\n2784\t  {\n2785\t    size_t n_obj = 0, n_store = 0, n_env = 0;\n2786\t    cov_context->foreach_operand([&](const symbolt &s) {\n2787\t      const std::string id = s.id.as_string();\n2788\t      const std::string base = s.name.as_string();\n2789\t      if (id.rfind(\"sol:@_ESBMC_Object_\", 0) == 0)\n2790\t      {\n2791\t        config.no_slice_names.insert(id);\n2792\t        ++n_obj;\n2793\t      }\n2794\t      else if (\n2795\t        id.rfind(\"sol:@C@\", 0) == 0 && id.find(\"@F@\") == std::string::npos)\n2796\t      {\n2797\t        config.no_slice_names.insert(id);\n2798\t        ++n_store;\n2799\t      }\n2800\t      else if (\n2801\t        base.rfind(\"msg_\", 0) == 0 || base.rfind(\"tx_\", 0) == 0 ||\n2802\t        base.rfind(\"block_\", 0) == 0)\n2803\t      {\n2804\t        config.no_slice_names.insert(id);\n2805\t        ++n_env;\n2806\t      }\n2807\t    });\n2808\t    log_status(\n2809\t      \"--solidity-path-coverage with --cov-report-json: exempting {} symbol(s) \"\n2810\t      \"from slicing so each path's counterexample values survive into the \"\n2811\t      \"report ({} contract object(s), {} contract-scope store(s), {} \"\n2812\t      \"environment); slicing stays enabled for everything else\",\n2813\t      n_obj + n_store + n_env,\n2814\t      n_obj,\n2815\t      n_store,\n2816\t      n_env);\n2817\t  }\n2818\t\n2819\t  // A function is a UNIT iff it is a public/external entry. The frontend\n2820\t  // creates `<function-id>#_sol_save_this` for exactly those (public /\n2821\t  // external / receive / fallback) and for nothing else, so the symbol's\n2822\t  // existence is the test — no new frontend signal is needed.\n2823\t  auto is_external_entry = [&](const irep_idt &fid) {\n2824\t    return ns.lookup(irep_idt(fid.as_string() + \"#_sol_save_this\")) != nullptr;\n2825\t  };\n2826\t\n2827\t  // Is any of this body's instructions in the user source? c2goto library\n2828\t  // models and the synthetic harness carry non-user locations.\n2829\t  auto body_in_user_src = [&](const goto_programt &p) {\n2830\t    forall_goto_program_instructions (uit, p)\n2831\t      if (location_pool.count(\n2832\t            get_filename_from_path(uit->location.file().as_string())))\n2833\t        return true;\n2834\t    return false;\n2835\t  };\n2836\t\n2837\t  // Is this instruction an INTERNAL call that must be expanded into the\n2838\t  // caller's path identity?\n2839\t  //\n2840\t  // Everything a Solidity contract calls directly by symbol is internal in the\n2841\t  // goto model. Measured on a `this.f(a)` self-call: the frontend lowers it to\n2842\t  // the very same direct FUNCTION_CALL as a plain `f(a)` and models no\n2843\t  // success/failure edge for it, so at this layer an external SELF-call is\n2844\t  // indistinguishable from an internal one — and there is nothing to branch on\n2845\t  // even if it were distinguished. A genuine external call (`addr.call{...}`,\n2846\t  // an interface method on another address) does not appear as a direct call\n2847\t  // to a user function at all: it goes through the `_ESBMC_Nondet_Extcall_*`\n2848\t  // model, which this predicate excludes, so it is left unexpanded and its\n2849\t  // success/failure stays a decision, as the methodology requires.\n2850\t  auto expandable_callee =\n2851\t    [&](goto_programt::const_targett i) -> const goto_functiont * {\n2852\t    if (!i->is_function_call() || !is_code_function_call2t(i->code))\n2853\t      return nullptr;\n2854\t    const expr2tc &callee = to_code_function_call2t(i->code).function;\n2855\t    if (!is_symbol2t(callee))\n2856\t      return nullptr;\n2857\t    const irep_idt cid = to_symbol2t(callee).thename;\n2858\t    const std::string cids = cid.as_string();\n2859\t    // Harness plumbing: the dispatcher and the external-call model are the\n2860\t    // boundary of the unit, never part of it.\n2861\t    if (\n2862\t      cids.find(\"_ESBMC_Main\") != std::string::npos ||\n2863\t      cids.find(\"_ESBMC_Nondet_Extcall\") != std::string::npos)\n2864\t      return nullptr;\n2865\t    // A lowered `revert E()` is a STATEMENT, not a call: its whole body is\n2866\t    // ASSUME(false) and the enumerator detects it by name to place the path's\n2867\t    // assert upstream of that assume. Expanding it would destroy that marker.\n2868\t    const symbolt *csym = ns.lookup(cid);\n2869\t    if (csym != nullptr && !csym->type.get(\"#sol_error\").as_string().empty())\n2870\t      return nullptr;\n2871\t    auto m_it = goto_functions.function_map.find(cid);\n2872\t    if (m_it == goto_functions.function_map.end())\n2873\t      return nullptr;\n2874\t    if (!m_it->second.body_available || m_it->second.body.hide)\n2875\t      return nullptr;\n2876\t    if (!body_in_user_src(m_it->second.body))\n2877\t      return nullptr;\n2878\t    return &m_it->second;\n2879\t  };\n2880\t\n2881\t  // Expand internal calls into every unit, so a callee's decisions become part\n2882\t  // of its caller's path identity. Bounded by path_cov_unwind passes: one pass\n2883\t  // expands exactly the calls present when it started, so pass count == call\n2884\t  // depth. Using the LOOP bound here is not a convenience — symex bounds\n2885\t  // recursion with the same --unwind, so any other value would enumerate paths\n2886\t  // the solver cannot reach (or miss ones it can).\n2887\t  optionst inline_opts;\n2888\t  sol_path_inlinet inliner(goto_functions, inline_opts, ns);\n2889\t  size_t inlined_calls = 0, residual_calls = 0;\n2890\t  std::set<std::string> residual_fns;\n2891\t  std::set<std::string> residual_unit_fns;\n2892\t  // Per unit: which UNIT callees it still calls unexpanded. This is not a\n2893\t  // reporting convenience — it is what the containment below is keyed on, so\n2894\t  // the marking reaches the right unit's paths instead of being a global count\n2895\t  // nobody acts on.\n2896\t  std::map<std::string, std::set<std::string>> residual_unit_callees_of;\n2897\t  // Measurement (§ \"path distribution\"): a snapshot of every unit's body BEFORE\n2898\t  // expansion, plus how many calls were expanded into it. Taken here because\n2899\t  // this is the last moment the pre-expansion shape exists.\n2900\t  std::map<std::string, goto_programt> pre_inline_body;\n2901\t  std::map<std::string, size_t> expanded_into_unit;\n2902\t  size_t degraded_units = 0, withdrawn_sites_total = 0;\n2903\t  size_t degradation_exhausted_units = 0;\n2904\t\n2905\t  // Identity of a CALL POINT for degradation: the callee plus the source\n2906\t  // location of the call expression. Deliberately not the goto instruction —\n2907\t  // after expansion the same source-level call exists as several physical\n2908\t  // copies (one per copy of the enclosing callee), and \"withdraw this call\"\n2909\t  // has to withdraw all of them or the unit's paths still multiply through the\n2910\t  // copies that were left behind. A synthesised call with no source location\n2911\t  // therefore folds together with its siblings, which errs towards withdrawing\n2912\t  // more: the safe direction, since withdrawing costs assertion strength while\n2913\t  // failing to withdraw costs the budget.\n2914\t  auto callee_id_of = [](goto_programt::const_targett i) {\n2915\t    const expr2tc &callee = to_code_function_call2t(i->code).function;\n2916\t    return to_symbol2t(callee).thename.as_string();\n2917\t  };\n2918\t  auto call_point_key = [&callee_id_of](goto_programt::const_targett i) {\n2919\t    return callee_id_of(i) + \" at \" + i->location.as_string();\n2920\t  };\n2921\t\n2922\t  // May this call point be withdrawn?\n2923\t  //\n2924\t  // NOT if the callee is itself a unit, and the reason is soundness rather than\n2925\t  // taste. Withdrawing means leaving a direct call to the callee's own body —\n2926\t  // and that body carries the synthesised ABI non-payable gate, which models an\n2927\t  // EXTERNAL entry. An internal call never runs that gate on-chain, so the model\n2928\t  // would admit \"the callee reverted because the transaction carried value\" in\n2929\t  // the middle of a caller that on-chain proceeds normally: a counterexample\n2930\t  // describing an execution that does not exist, i.e. a test that is red on the\n2931\t  // unmodified contract. Physical expansion is exactly what fixes that (the\n2932\t  // caller's copy is gate-free), so undoing it for a unit callee re-opens the\n2933\t  // hole. Internal/private helpers have no gate and are safe to withdraw.\n2934\t  auto withdrawable = [&](goto_programt::const_targett i) {\n2935\t    return !is_external_entry(irep_idt(callee_id_of(i)));\n2936\t  };\n2937\t\n2938\t  // Expand every expandable call into `b` EXCEPT those whose call-point key is\n2939\t  // in `withdrawn`. One pass expands exactly the calls that were present when\n2940\t  // it started, so the pass index is the call's depth from the unit entry; that\n2941\t  // is both what bounds recursion and what `sites` records alongside each key.\n2942\t  // Only withdrawable call points are offered as candidates in `sites`.\n2943\t  auto expand_into = [&](\n2944\t                       goto_programt &b,\n2945\t                       const std::set<std::string> &withdrawn,\n2946\t                       std::map<std::string, size_t> *sites) -> size_t {\n2947\t    size_t n = 0;\n2948\t    for (size_t round = 0; round < path_cov_unwind; ++round)\n2949\t    {\n2950\t      bool changed = false;\n2951\t      for (auto it = b.instructions.begin(); it != b.instructions.end();)\n2952\t      {\n2953\t        const goto_functiont *callee = expandable_callee(it);\n2954\t        if (callee == nullptr)\n2955\t        {\n2956\t          ++it;\n2957\t          continue;\n2958\t        }\n2959\t        if (withdrawn.count(call_point_key(it)) != 0)\n2960\t        {\n2961\t          // Left as a plain call: this IS the degradation. The DFS walks over a\n2962\t          // call as a straight-line instruction, so the callee contributes no\n2963\t          // decisions to this unit's path identity — while symex still executes\n2964\t          // it, so the model is unchanged and only the recording is coarser.\n2965\t          ++it;\n2966\t          continue;\n2967\t        }\n2968\t        if (sites != nullptr && withdrawable(it))\n2969\t          sites->emplace(call_point_key(it), round);\n2970\t        inliner.expand_here(b, it, *callee);\n2971\t        ++n;\n2972\t        changed = true;\n2973\t      }\n2974\t      if (!changed)\n2975\t        break;\n2976\t      remove_no_op(b);\n2977\t      b.update();\n2978\t    }\n2979\t    return n;\n2980\t  };\n2981\t\n2982\t  // Complete-path count of `b` under the same rules the DFS uses, capped so a\n2983\t  // runaway unit costs bounded work. Anything past the cap comes back as\n2984\t  // cap + 1, which is all a budget comparison needs.\n2985\t  auto count_paths_of = [&](const goto_programt &b, size_t cap) -> size_t {\n2986\t    bool hit = false;\n2987\t    const size_t n = count_paths_no_instrument(b, ns, path_cov_unwind, cap, hit);\n2988\t    return hit ? cap + 1 : n;\n2989\t  };\n2990\t\n2991\t  // The budget a unit's enumeration has to fit into. One goal is held back for\n2992\t  // the ABI non-payable gate, which is synthesised AFTER this point and adds\n2993\t  // exactly one path: without the reservation a unit could be brought to\n2994\t  // exactly the cap here and then handed straight to the truncation backstop by\n2995\t  // the gate, which is precisely the ordering this is meant to prevent.\n2996\t  const size_t unit_budget =\n2997\t    path_cov_max_goals > 1 ? path_cov_max_goals - 1 : 1;\n2998\t\n2999\t  // Why each unit ended up where it did. Recorded rather than re-derived,\n3000\t  // because the truncation backstop's report has to distinguish three different\n3001\t  // situations that all look identical at the cap: a policy that was not\n3002\t  // aggressive enough, a unit that had nothing left to give up, and the\n3003\t  // estimator disagreeing with the enumeration. Only the last is a defect.\n3004\t  enum class budget_statet\n3005\t  {\n3006\t    fits,          // the pre-enumeration count was already inside the budget\n3007\t    no_candidates, // over budget, with no withdrawable call point at all\n3008\t    degraded_fits, // withdrawals brought it inside the budget\n3009\t    degraded_over  // everything withdrawable is gone and it is still over\n3010\t  };\n3011\t  std::map<std::string, budget_statet> budget_state;\n3012\t  // The path count the budget decision was actually taken on, per unit. Kept so\n3013\t  // that when the cap fires anyway the report can print the pre-enumeration\n3014\t  // number NEXT TO the enumerated one: the two are produced by different code\n3015\t  // (a flat counter vs the enumerating DFS) and a gap between them is a\n3016\t  // COUNTING-UNIT mismatch to be reconciled, not automatically a bug. Printing\n3017\t  // one number and calling it a failure would send someone hunting for a defect\n3018\t  // that may not exist.\n3019\t  std::map<std::string, size_t> estimated_paths;\n3020\t\n3021\t  Forall_goto_functions (e_it, goto_functions)\n3022\t  {\n3023\t    if (!e_it->second.body_available || e_it->first == \"__ESBMC_main\")\n3024\t      continue;\n3025\t    goto_programt &b = e_it->second.body;\n3026\t    if (filter(e_it->first, b))\n3027\t      continue;\n3028\t    if (!is_external_entry(e_it->first))\n3029\t      continue;\n3030\t    if (\n3031\t      !scope_contract.empty() &&\n3032\t      contract_of(e_it->first.as_string()) != scope_contract)\n3033\t      continue;\n3034\t    if (!body_in_user_src(b))\n3035\t      continue;\n3036\t\n3037\t    const std::string uname = e_it->first.as_string();\n3038\t    pre_inline_body[uname].copy_from(b);\n3039\t\n3040\t    // Expand everything first and measure. Almost every unit fits, and for\n3041\t    // those this is the only expansion performed and `b` is already the body we\n3042\t    // want — the degradation machinery below costs nothing.\n3043\t    std::map<std::string, size_t> sites;\n3044\t    size_t expanded_here = expand_into(b, {}, &sites);\n3045\t    std::set<std::string> withdrawn;\n3046\t    std::vector<std::string> withdrawn_order;\n3047\t\n3048\t    const size_t full_paths = count_paths_of(b, unit_budget);\n3049\t    estimated_paths[uname] = full_paths;\n3050\t    if (full_paths <= unit_budget)\n3051\t      budget_state[uname] = budget_statet::fits;\n3052\t    else if (sites.empty())\n3053\t    {\n3054\t      // Over budget with nothing to give up: either the unit has no internal\n3055\t      // calls at all, or every call it has is to another UNIT and withdrawing\n3056\t      // those would re-open the ABI-gate hole (see `withdrawable`). Say so\n3057\t      // here, before the enumeration runs, so the truncation that follows reads\n3058\t      // as the declared consequence of a budget rather than as a surprise.\n3059\t      budget_state[uname] = budget_statet::no_candidates;\n3060\t      log_warning(\n3061\t        \"--solidity-path-coverage: unit '{}' is over the per-unit budget ({}) \"\n3062\t        \"and degradation has NOTHING it may withdraw — the unit's own source \"\n3063\t        \"decisions already exceed the budget, or its only internal calls are to \"\n3064\t        \"public/external functions, which must stay expanded (their bodies \"\n3065\t        \"carry the ABI value gate, which an internal call does not run \"\n3066\t        \"on-chain). The goal cap will therefore truncate this unit; raise \"\n3067\t        \"--path-cov-max-goals to enumerate it\",\n3068\t        uname,\n3069\t        path_cov_max_goals);\n3070\t    }\n3071\t    else\n3072\t    {\n3073\t      // ---- DEGRADATION (fires BEFORE the truncation backstop) ----\n3074\t      //\n3075\t      // Measured motivation: on a real benchmark one contract enumerated 120166\n3076\t      // paths across 39 units, 12 of which were over the cap on their own. At\n3077\t      // that size the choice is not \"enumerate or not\" but \"give up resolution\n3078\t      // deliberately, or have it taken away by a cap\". Those are not the same:\n3079\t      // the cap DROPS paths that exist in the model, so nothing downstream can\n3080\t      // subtract their inputs from a surviving path's certified region;\n3081\t      // withdrawing a call point instead makes the surviving classes coarser\n3082\t      // while they still cover the whole input space.\n3083\t      //\n3084\t      // Which call points: measured, not estimated. Each candidate is expanded\n3085\t      // once with itself withheld and the resulting path count recorded, so\n3086\t      // \"cuts the most paths\" is a number rather than a guess. Ties break\n3087\t      // towards the call FURTHEST from the entry, where the decisions are least\n3088\t      // directly controlled by the unit's own arguments and the assertion\n3089\t      // strength given up is worth least.\n3090\t      //\n3091\t      // The ranking is measured once and then applied greedily. Re-ranking\n3092\t      // after every withdrawal would be quadratic for no soundness benefit:\n3093\t      // soundness does not depend on the choice at all, only the strength of\n3094\t      // what survives does, and the result is reported per unit either way.\n3095\t      std::vector<std::tuple<size_t, size_t, std::string>> ranked;\n3096\t      ranked.reserve(sites.size());\n3097\t      for (const auto &[key, depth] : sites)\n3098\t      {\n3099\t        std::set<std::string> trial{key};\n3100\t        goto_programt probe;\n3101\t        probe.copy_from(pre_inline_body[uname]);\n3102\t        expand_into(probe, trial, nullptr);\n3103\t        // Sorting ascending on (paths left, SIZE_MAX - depth) puts the biggest\n3104\t        // cut first and, among equal cuts, the deepest call first.\n3105\t        ranked.emplace_back(\n3106\t          count_paths_of(probe, unit_budget), SIZE_MAX - depth, key);\n3107\t      }\n3108\t      std::sort(ranked.begin(), ranked.end());\n3109\t\n3110\t      bool fits = false;\n3111\t      for (const auto &r : ranked)\n3112\t      {\n3113\t        withdrawn.insert(std::get<2>(r));\n3114\t        withdrawn_order.push_back(std::get<2>(r));\n3115\t        b = pre_inline_body[uname];\n3116\t        expanded_here = expand_into(b, withdrawn, nullptr);\n3117\t        estimated_paths[uname] = count_paths_of(b, unit_budget);\n3118\t        if (estimated_paths[uname] <= unit_budget)\n3119\t        {\n3120\t          fits = true;\n3121\t          break;\n3122\t        }\n3123\t      }\n3124\t\n3125\t      budget_state[uname] =\n3126\t        fits ? budget_statet::degraded_fits : budget_statet::degraded_over;\n3127\t      ++degraded_units;\n3128\t      withdrawn_sites_total += withdrawn_order.size();\n3129\t      degraded_call_sites[uname] = withdrawn_order;\n3130\t      std::string names;\n3131\t      for (const auto &w : withdrawn_order)\n3132\t        names += (names.empty() ? \"\" : \"; \") + w;\n3133\t      log_warning(\n3134\t        \"--solidity-path-coverage: DEGRADED unit '{}' — fully expanded it \"\n3135\t        \"enumerates more paths than the per-unit budget ({}), so {} call \"\n3136\t        \"point(s) were WITHDRAWN from its path identity and are now treated as \"\n3137\t        \"black boxes: {}. The callees still EXECUTE (the call is still there), \"\n3138\t        \"they just stop contributing decisions, so the path classes get coarser \"\n3139\t        \"while still partitioning the input space — sound, with weaker \"\n3140\t        \"assertions, and weaker exactly at the call points named here. This is \"\n3141\t        \"tried BEFORE the goal cap on purpose: the cap would instead DROP paths \"\n3142\t        \"that exist in the model\",\n3143\t        uname,\n3144\t        path_cov_max_goals,\n3145\t        withdrawn_order.size(),\n3146\t        names);\n3147\t      if (!fits)\n3148\t      {\n3149\t        ++degradation_exhausted_units;\n3150\t        log_warning(\n3151\t          \"--solidity-path-coverage: unit '{}' is STILL over the budget ({}) \"\n3152\t          \"with every one of its {} call point(s) withdrawn — its own source \"\n3153\t          \"decisions alone exceed it. Degradation has nothing left to give up, \"\n3154\t          \"so the goal cap will act as the backstop and that unit's truncation \"\n3155\t          \"is expected rather than a policy failure\",\n3156\t          uname,\n3157\t          path_cov_max_goals,\n3158\t          withdrawn_order.size());\n3159\t      }\n3160\t    }\n3161\t\n3162\t    // Anything still callable after the last pass is recursion deeper than the\n3163\t    // bound. Its decisions are NOT in this unit's path identity, so the paths\n3164\t    // through it are merged rather than enumerated. That is a silent loss of\n3165\t    // resolution unless it is reported, so report it. Call points withdrawn by\n3166\t    // degradation are excluded here: they are also unexpanded, but deliberately\n3167\t    // and with their own report, and merging the two would make a budget\n3168\t    // decision read as a depth-bound overflow.\n3169\t    forall_goto_program_instructions (it, b)\n3170\t    {\n3171\t      const goto_functiont *callee = expandable_callee(it);\n3172\t      if (callee == nullptr)\n3173\t        continue;\n3174\t      if (withdrawn.count(call_point_key(it)) != 0)\n3175\t        continue;\n3176\t      ++residual_calls;\n3177\t      const std::string cid = callee_id_of(it);\n3178\t      residual_fns.insert(cid);\n3179\t      // A residual call to a UNIT is not a loss of resolution — it is the SAME\n3180\t      // hole that degradation refuses to open, arrived at from the other side.\n3181\t      //\n3182\t      // A unit's body is DOUBLE-IDENTITY: the copy expanded into a caller models\n3183\t      // an internal call (no ABI value gate), while the unit's own body models an\n3184\t      // external entry (gated). That is precisely what physical expansion buys.\n3185\t      // Leaving a call to the unit's own body unexpanded makes an INTERNAL call\n3186\t      // use the EXTERNAL-entry body, so the model admits \"the callee reverted\n3187\t      // because the transaction carried value\" inside a caller that on-chain\n3188\t      // proceeds. That execution does not exist on chain, and a test built from a\n3189\t      // counterexample containing it is RED on the unmodified contract.\n3190\t      //\n3191\t      // So this is contained, not merely named. Same symbol family the counterexample\n3344\t      // harvest reads `final_state` from, so a coordinate named here and a\n3345\t      // value reported there refer to the same thing by construction.\n3346\t      const symbolt *obj = nullptr;\n3347\t      cov_context->foreach_operand([&](const symbolt &s) {\n3348\t        if (obj != nullptr)\n3349\t          return;\n3350\t        const std::string id = s.id.as_string();\n3351\t        if (\n3352\t          id.rfind(\"sol:@_ESBMC_Object_\", 0) == 0 &&\n3353\t          (scope_contract.empty() ||\n3354\t           id.find(scope_contract) != std::string::npos))\n3355\t          obj = &s;\n3356\t      });\n3357\t      if (obj == nullptr)\n3358\t        return false;\n3359\t      const typet ostruct = ns.follow(obj->type);\n3360\t      if (ostruct.id() != \"struct\")\n3361\t        return false;\n3362\t      // Same field walk as for struct parameters below, so a struct-typed state\n3363\t      // variable is reachable field by field too (`state.cfg.limit`). That test\n3489\t    //    cannot replay, which is the one thing this pass must never emit.\n3490\t    //\n3491\t    // Synthesise the check here, at the front, so Phase 1 snapshots it and\n3492\t    // Phase 2 enumerates it like any other decision:\n3493\t    //\n3494\t    //     IF msg_value == 0 THEN GOTO <original first instruction>\n3495\t    //     _ESBMC_sol_mark_revert();      // makes exit_kind = revert\n3496\t    //     GOTO <END_FUNCTION>\n3497\t    //\n3498\t    // `#sol_payable` is already stamped on the function type\n3499\t    // (solidity_convert_modifier.cpp), so no frontend change is needed to know\n3500\t    // where the gate applies.\n3501\t    //\n3502\t    // Placing it in the body is correct here ONLY because of the expansion\n3503\t    // above. (Measured before this was fixed: a two-path function\n3537\t          // enumerated 64 paths and reported a truncated loop.) std::list\n3538\t          // insert keeps `body_start` attached to the original instruction.\n3539\t          goto_programt::instructiont brk;\n3540\t          brk.type = GOTO;\n3541\t          brk.guard = equality2tc(mv_expr, zero);\n3542\t          brk.location = loc;\n3543\t          // MARK IT AS SYNTHETIC AT THE SOURCE. silently the day `msg_value` is renamed.\n3551\t          brk.location.set(\"sol_abi_value_gate\", true);\n3552\t          brk.function = fn;\n3553\t          auto it_brk = code_function_call2tc(\n3558\t            expr2tc(),\n3559\t            symbol2tc(migrate_type(mark->type), mark->id),\n3560\t            std::vector<expr2tc>());\n3561\t          call.location =
